sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Danielbrdz/Barcenas-27b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The goal of this model is to have a relatively large model optimized in Spanish and that was at the level of the first versions of GPT-4. I am proud of this model for being the biggest and most powerful one I have done, no doubt it is the result of my short stay in the AI world. Made with ️ in Guadalupe, Nuevo Leon, Mexico 🇲🇽
